title: VexStream Playback · Screen Lens Reference
summary: Stable human-authored reference for the VexStream screen: current source-earned non-Playback relationships remain aligned with the generated lens while Play / Pause demonstrates the runtime-connected Playback Family round trip. This is an oracle for VexBoard experience and later adapter equivalence, not live source authority.

notes: Stable Screen Lens reference case: current VexStream screen projection plus a hand-authored Playback relationship oracle. It is not the live generated lens and does not own VexLife behavior.

Existing VexStream element ids and source-earned non-Playback pathways are preserved from the generated 305a09e lens; unproven localEffect controls stay visible without invented generic pathways. The Play / Pause pathway is grounded in the accepted VexStream Playback source slice and rechecked against the same pinned source.
Later adapter work succeeds only when generation can reproduce this relationship without changing the VexBoard consumer contract.

pathways.label: VexStream Playback · Play / Pause
pathways.summary: The visible Play / Pause doorway carries one typed Playback Control through the Experience into the current Connection. Playback Behavior owns State → Act → Effect meaning; Media3 owns physical playback truth; provider observation is reconciled back into the same Playback projection.
pathways.returns: The reconciled VexStreamPlaybackProjection and DisplayState return to the same mini-player Play / Pause control.

nodes.label: localEffect()
nodes.summary: The registered element declares only that feature-local behavior will handle this touch; it does not itself claim Playback meaning.

nodes.label: VexStreamPlaybackExperience.activate(PlayPause)
nodes.summary: The visible Play / Pause manifestations forward the same Family-bound Control through the UI-facing Playback Experience membrane.

nodes.label: VexStreamPlaybackControl.PlayPause
nodes.summary: Family-bound semantic input. The Control blueprint maps it to Play or Pause according to exact current State.

nodes.label: CURRENT VexStreamPlaybackState · NoMedia | Media | Ended
nodes.summary: Current semantic playback truth derived from Media3 plus still-pending local intent.

nodes.label: PlayPause → Play | Pause
nodes.summary: The Control blueprint chooses the lawful Act for the exact current State; NoMedia admits no PlayPause Act.

nodes.label: RequestPlay | RequestPause | RestartCurrent
nodes.summary: Behavior resolves Play/Pause against current State. Ended + Play becomes RestartCurrent rather than pretending it is the ordinary RequestPlay case.

nodes.label: current.afterIntent(effect)
nodes.summary: Semantic State reflects the admitted request immediately while pending flags explicitly avoid claiming provider convergence.

nodes.label: VexStreamPlaybackProjection
nodes.summary: The Connection publishes Family-owned current meaning as a VexBehaviorProjection; presentation consumes it without becoming semantic truth.

nodes.label: VexStreamPlaybackDisplayState → Play / Pause presentation
nodes.summary: The Experience derives one display classification and the player presents the current Play/Pause icon and availability back to the human.

nodes.label: VexStreamPlaybackConnectionViewModel
nodes.summary: Android configuration-lifetime owner of the concrete Playback Connection. It is construction/lifetime support, not semantic playback truth.

nodes.label: VexStreamPlaybackConnection / Flow → Media3VexStreamPlaybackConnection
nodes.summary: Typed VexPort boundary carrying the same Playback Family / State / Control / Act coordinates into the Media3 realization and reconciliation owner.

nodes.label: MediaController / Player
nodes.summary: Physical playback reality. The Connection requests play/pause/restart here; this outside owner does not adopt Playback semantic State.

nodes.label: Player.Listener → publishObserved()
nodes.summary: Asynchronous Media3 observations re-enter through the same concrete Connection.

nodes.label: reconcileVexStreamPlaybackObservation(observed, pending)
nodes.summary: A stale callback cannot erase newer admitted intent. Pending clears only when provider truth acknowledges it or incompatible terminal truth invalidates it.

annotations.text: Stable reference case, not a second source of truth
annotations.detail: The screen/element tree and source-earned non-Playback pathways are copied from the generated lens at 305a09e, including truthful held localEffect controls and typed operand-specific pathways. The Playback pathway remains hand-authored from the accepted VexStream Playback source slice so VexBoard retains a stable visual oracle without becoming source authority.

annotations.text: Pending intent is connection-local implementation state
annotations.detail: VexStreamPlaybackPending is explicitly a shock absorber, not a fifth Behavior concept. Public semantic truth remains VexStreamPlaybackState.
